uncited: Calculate the effective distance for fog calculation.
If the hit distance `tr.t` is less than `FOG_START`, the effective distance is 0.
Compute the raw fog factor using the Beer-Lambert law.
Clamp the fog factor to prevent complete obscuration of the scene.
Blend the object color with the fog color using the fog factor.
